# SmartNexus Ecosystems
An interactive smart study platform and IoT dashboard suite for tracking educational progress and device ecosystems. Built with Firebase and modern web technologies.

## Core Information
- [Homepage](https://smart-study-site.web.app/) — Primary landing page with access to all tools and dashboards
- [Smart Study Wiki](https://smart-study-wiki.web.app/) — Comprehensive IGCSE study wiki covering Chemistry, Biology, Physics, Computer Science, and Mathematics with past paper data
- [SmartNexus App](https://smartnexus.web.app/) — IoT ecosystem dashboard for tracking and managing smart devices

## Projects & Tools
- **Smart Study Wiki**: Static knowledge base built with Quartz, containing thousands of IGCSE past paper Q&A pairs classified by topic
- **SmartNexus Chat**: Real-time messaging interface with Firebase backend
- **Staff Portal**: Internal management dashboard for administrators

## Technical Stack
- Hosting: Google Firebase (multi-site hosting)
- Static Site: Quartz (markdown-to-HTML with full-text search)
- Real-time: Firebase Realtime Database
- Authentication: Firebase Auth
- Storage: Firebase Storage / Cloud Firestore
